thread:
Maria G: Heads-up — proposing a lightweight traffic-containment + "lite" canary protocol for the rerank v2 flag. Goal: minimize customer impact while we validate quality and perf. TL;DR: small regional slices, short A/B window, strict SLO gates, and an automatic fallback to rerank v1.
Samir K: couple questions — what slice sizes are you thinking? 1% global or fixed per-region buckets?
Maria G: prefer per-region buckets so we can isolate regional perf regressions. thinking 2% per-region for the first 24h, then 5% if gates pass.
Jordan L: gating metrics proposal: 
- quality: F1/regression delta on curated prompts <= 1.5%
- perf: p95 latency delta <= 15% and tail tokens/sec within budget
- errors: error-rate bump <= 0.1pp
If any fails, auto-rollback.
Priya S: add explicit kill-switch criteria for customer-impact signals: 
- >0.5% increase in user-facing 5xx
- >2% drop in successful completions for production prompts in last 10m
- manual override from SRE/product on-duty
Liam O'Neill: ops note — be careful with cross-region capacity. if we route slices to specific GPU pools we need a fallback routing table so traffic can failover to similar-capacity pools in the region. Also limit concurrent canaries to 3 per cluster.
Maria G: agreed. plan will include a routing fallback matrix: primary slice -> fallback pool(s) -> degrade to rerank v1.
Samir K: can we codify the flow? something like:
```
flow:
  1. enable flag at 2% per-region
  2. run A/B for 4h with shadow logging
  3. evaluate gates every 15m
  4. if gates pass for 24h -> increase to 5%
  5. if any gate trips -> immediate rollback + postmortem
```
Jordan L: suggestion: add a short randomized A/B cohort for behavioral signals (clicks/retention) — 1% holdout for 7 days, but only after perf/quality gates are satisfied. keeps launch incremental.
Priya S: also add an emergency fast-fail label on the flag so SRE can flip to 'safe' instantly. UI + API path must be <30s to flip globally.
ops-bot: deploy window reminder: scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canaries outside that window preferred. :calendar:
deploy-bot: rollout job queued (rerank-v2-lite-canary). job id: rb-20260321-77.
Maria G: next steps: I'll draft the rollout doc with the matrix (slices, fallback pools, gate thresholds) and ownership table. @Samir @Priya please review before EOD. If no objections, we run the lite canary on Thursday. :thumbsup:
Samir K: reviewing now, will comment on the slices.
Priya S: looks good to me, will verify kill-switch automation with SRE runbook team.
Liam O'Neill: I'll prepare fallback pool mapping and circuit-breaker playbook.
Maria G: thanks — will post the doc link once ready and set a short shiproom to align ops/product/sre.
